$comment: Reconciliation manifest for the local CI gate. Read by packages/scripts-ts/src/check-ci-drift.ts.
One entry per step in .github/workflows, keyed by '<workflow>::<job>::<step name>'.
hash   - content hash of the step (run/uses + with + env + if) when it was last
reconciled. The guard recomputes it; a mismatch fails the gate.
mirror - the local command asserted to cover this step, or null when exempt.
reason - why the mirror covers it, or why it cannot run locally. Required.
IMPORTANT: `mirror` is a HUMAN ASSERTION, not something the guard verifies. The
guard's job is to make sure that assertion is re-made whenever the CI step changes,
so the local gate cannot drift out of sync in silence. When a hash mismatch sends
you here, actually re-read the workflow step before bumping the hash.

react-doctor.yml::react-doctor::React Do.reason: just react-doctor runs the identical pnpm dlx react-doctor@0.9.12 --scope files --base <diff_base> --blocking warning --no-telemetry --verbose from apps/front; CI now supplies the per-event diff base via the Resolve diff base step instead of the hardcoded origin/<base_ref>.

react-doctor.yml::react-doctor::Resolve.reason: GitHub-only: derives a single DIFF_BASE per event (pull_request -> origin/<base_ref>, merge_group -> the merge-group base sha, push -> github.event.before with a HEAD~1 fallback for a brand-new branch) so the Assert diff base is present step and --base cannot drift. The checkout uses fetch-depth: 0, so the resolved base is present locally without fetching.

react-doctor.yml::react-doctor::Setup No.reason: GitHub-only Node setup. Locally the Node version is pinned by .node-version / .nvmrc.

require-linked-issue.yml::require-linked.reason: Reads github.event.pull_request.body. At pre-push time there is no PR and therefore no body to check, so this gate is unreproducible locally by construction rather than by omission. The step gained a #1240 waiver that short-circuits to success for PR_AUTHOR == 'dependabot[bot]' (exact-login policy, not github.actor, not a label); the waiver's exact shape is guarded by packages/scripts-ts/src/require-linked-issue.test.ts, which just ci-drift now runs, but the step itself (which reads the live PR body) stays a GitHub-only required check.

quality-gate.yml::quality::Typecheck lin.reason: ci-lint-ts runs the identical pnpm --filter @org/lint-ts typecheck (tsc --noEmit) that this step runs. The package ships the repo's custom publy/* oxlint rules that guard every front surface, but nothing verified its own types — only its vitest tests ran (the step above). See issue #1600.
